authority: DX1036 bounded disposable cleanup; preserve active/shared/private warm graphs and required source basis
reconstruction: Exact local transport payloads remain in the bounded per-batch evidence; historical scripts can re-upload them if replay is explicitly required. Source and build bases were not removed.

active_source_basis.purpose: Required active Workbench source and Saved artifact basis.

user_cache_alias_and_home.purpose: Active image-keyed cache aliases and writable home; symlinks are not followed in size measurement.

active_shared_full_ros_cache.purpose: Active warm native graphs, frontend dependencies and shared build products.

private_warm_build_graph.purpose: Qualified independent native graph retained for incremental follow-up builds.

private_required_source_basis.purpose: Required source mapping for the retained private CMake graph.

private_cache_alias_and_home.purpose: Private image-keyed cache aliases/home; symlinks are not followed.

private_qualification_evidence.purpose: Bounded build, test and runtime qualification records.

private_runtime_and_archives.purpose: Durable private session journals and preserved archives.

older_private_qualification_root_pending.purpose: Retained; this batch has no authority to discard its warm graph, source or evidence.

user_runtime_and_archives.purpose: Active user journals, stable History and previous-session archives.

retention_limits: Sizes are point-in-time allocated-byte measurements; aliases may overlap other entries and must not be summed as unique disk usage.
No Docker images, shared compiler/dependency caches, source trees, build graphs, runtime journals, History, archives or evidence were deleted.
Owned implementation worktrees were removed separately by their source owners; their receipts remain.
